Bug_Title: Consumed Stream pipelines should not be reused
Bug_Explanation: The bug is in the reuse of the Stream pipeline after it has been consumed. The terminal operation count() is being called twice on the same pipeline.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered when the test calls the showBug method and tries to perform further operations on the same stream pipeline after the terminal operation has been performed. This will result in an IllegalStateException.

Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results confirm the presence of the described bug in the Java code. The test execution results show that the second count operation on the stream pipeline returns 0, which is unexpected. This is because the stream pipeline has already been consumed by the first count operation, and cannot be reused. This is in line with the bug description: 'Stream operations are divided into intermediate and terminal operations, and are combined to form stream pipelines. After the terminal operation is performed, the stream pipeline is considered consumed, and cannot be used again. Such a reuse will yield unexpected results.'
